mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ref_order_line(order_id, ref_data_id, supplier_name, strain_name, spec_name, spec_selections, hierarchy_chain, quantity, unit_price, arrival_date, pickup_room_id, pickup_room_name, collector_id, collector_name, line_remark, added_by, aup_record_id) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{refDataId}, #{supplierName}, #{strainName}, #{specName}, #{specSelections}, #{hierarchyChain}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{arrivalDate}, #{pickupRoomId}, #{pickupRoomName}, #{collectorId}, #{collectorName}, #{lineRemark}, #{addedBy}, #{aupRecordId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, ref_data_id, supplier_name, strain_name, spec_name, spec_selections, hierarchy_chain, quantity, unit_price, arrival_date, pickup_room_id, pickup_room_name, collector_id, collector_name, line_remark, added_by, aup_record_id FROM ref_order_line WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id ASC
